lines: Today, the Office of Health announced a breakthrough in their Spoilage research.

However, trusted sources report that these quote-unquote 'breakthroughs' are nothing but smoke and mirrors, as the lab has been sitting on their hands for so long that they can't even make up new lies!
By comparing today's interviews with another from two weeks ago, we found that they are one and the same.
Same voice, same script, same cadence, all the way to the 'um's and 'uhh's!
Shame on them for dragging their feet while people suffer on the streets this very day.
